Fourteen comments

This is the second John Stenson’s reels played by Kevin Burke on ‘If The Cap Fits’. He includes the two reels in a 3-tune set starting with a G-dorian setting of The Star of Munster.

↳ Posted by CreadurMawnOrganig on November 27th, 2002.

John Stensons No.2

Another one from If the cap fits, still one of my favourite albums.
I already have all the tunes from this album noted in sheet music form, and to get used to ABC I am converting them all
Does anyone know who John Stenson is or was?
Good Luck.

↳ Posted by Mikea on July 12th, 2003.

Michael, The Stensons are relatives of Kevin Burke and live in Co. Sligo. John Stenson was a box player and Kevin learned the tune from him. I think the story (or part of it) is on the sleeve notes of one of KB

# Two duplications rescued by ceolachan - March 22nd, 2008

↳ Posted by ceolachan on March 15th, 2020.

X:1

I just came here to copy the link to this tune as a reference in a discussion, and noticed that the first setting was missing the penultimate bar from the B-part (which nobody seems to have picked up on in the comments)… Then I noticed that that setting was submitted by none other than myself, 23 years ago! The omission has now been duly rectified.

It is very annoying when the first setting of a tune is a duffer. If you have ever been sitting next to a trad novice in a session that played some strange lopsided version of this tune, it’s probably my fault. My apologies.
